chunks.rationale: ThreadView chips are the gate: static markup proves dismissed/resolved rows are omitted, mounted clicks prove the three actions fire with the same suggestion object, and in-flight disables only that row. fakeCoder records the two new channels so App-level wiring can be asserted later.
risks: Static render uses empty messages; the strip must still mount after the timeline loop, not inside a message-only branch
The pending-click test depends on act() flushing setInFlight before the assertion; a microtask-only disable would flake

chunks.rationale: App start/file/dismiss must not interrupt the current run. Start captures the suggesting threadId before forkThread auto-selects, starts the prompt on the fork, then resolves the source chip. File uses the selected project's path, leaves the chip open on in-band create failure, and toasts r.reason. Dismiss is a single resolveSuggestion.
risks: forkThread selects the new thread; resolving with selectedThreadId after await would stamp the fork instead of the source — the handler snapshots threadId first
handleFileSuggestion reads project.path; it must sit after the project lookup (it does, ~line 690) or TDZ would throw on click
createIssue failures stay in-band; if the toast is dismissed the chip is still open, which is intended

chunks.rationale: SuggestedWorkStrip is quiet UI under the transcript (not a tool card). useCoder.resolveSuggestion merges like setNotes; createIssue is in-band like setIssuePlanStatus; forkThread passes worktree. wireClient and devCoder implement the CoderApi gap so typecheck is green; the browser fixture seeds one open chip on thread-1.
risks: Strip filters status===open in the renderer; a backend that leaves stale open rows would keep showing them
devCoder resolveSuggestion is dumb (no unknown-id reject) — electron main owns the real guards
No App-level test for the start/file/dismiss sequence (fork + startRun + resolveSuggestion). ThreadView tests are the gate as specified.
Sibling electron worker must implement threads:resolveSuggestion and issues:create or production clicks will reject
